traps.note: The example hands the solver the literal config key and the raw config-write route.
No rebase, exec, -x or flag wording; only the general every-invocation/'however the library passes that value' property covers it.
Clusters, attached values and the per-command switch table are unmentioned; covered only by the general arrival clause.
Rename-section is never named or described; a one-bug config instruction would carry the same 'recorded in the repository's configuration as a command' sentence.
The argument separator is unmentioned; only 'however the library passes that value to git' generalises over it.
